I configured my TCP/IP settings with IP 192.168.0.2 and subnet 255.255.255.0 for the PC, and IP 192.168.0.1 with the same subnet in the [product_name] interface. Despite this, communication is unsuccessful. Second, after scrolling through the menu on the [product_name] screen, the display became stuck on the 'Setup, Network, Diagnostics' page.
